name: Bilgeri Irma
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Bilgeri Irma is located in Nesselwängle in the Tannheimer Tal in Tirol. The accommodation is designed as a private holiday apartment and is suitable for self-catering. The apartment has a kitchenette and a bathroom. It offers sleeping places for several people. The furnishings are functional and geared to the needs of holidaymakers. In the surroundings of Nesselwängle there are hiking trails in summer and ski slopes in winter. The municipality is conveniently accessible via the B199. The holiday apartment represents an alternative to accommodation establishments.
